title: How to plan your Identiverse 2027 trip to Las Vegas
summary: Plan Identiverse 2027 in Las Vegas with Mandalay Bay hotels, airport, budget, agenda, dining, and AI travel assistant tips.
body_markdown:
Identiverse 2027 takes place June 28–July 1 at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas. The four-day event serves more than 3,000 digital identity, cybersecurity, and privacy professionals and includes keynotes, conference content, hands-on learning, and a show floor.\[1\]


The trip is most useful when you arrive with specific questions that need answers, like architecture, governance, non-human identity, fraud, privacy, or workforce access — and let those questions shape the week.


### Key takeaways


- Stay at Mandalay Bay or within the south Strip campus when avoiding outdoor travel in late-June heat is the priority.
- Las Vegas’s FY 2027 June and July allowance is $120 for lodging and $86 for meals and incidental expenses.\[4\]
- Harry Reid International Airport is roughly 2 miles from Mandalay Bay; rideshare and taxi are the simplest direct choices.\[3\]
- Registration currently lists a $1,695 general rate and a $1,395 government, nonprofit, and education rate, subject to eligibility and change.\[2\]
- Navan Edge can book LAS flights, Mandalay Bay-area hotels, and client dinners in one chat thread.


## What is Identiverse and who is it for?


Identiverse is an annual conference focused on digital identity and digital trust. The event has served the community for 16 years and attracts more than 3,000 professionals for four days of learning, keynotes, workshops, and a show floor with more than 200 solution providers, integrators, and industry associations.\[1\]


Attendees are known to include identity architects, IAM leaders, CISOs, security engineers, privacy specialists, fraud teams, product leaders, consultants, standards participants, and technology vendors. The 2027 edition is scheduled for June 28–July 1 at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas.\[1\]\[2\]


## What makes Identiverse 2027 worth the trip


Identity decisions sit between security, user experience, compliance, and business operations. Identiverse gives teams a place to test those trade-offs with practitioners and vendors, exploring:


- **Architecture depth:** Compare workforce, customer, privileged, and non-human identity approaches with people who operate them. Ask where trust is established, how identity proofing or lifecycle events are handled, and what fails when a dependency is unavailable.
- **Security context:** Connect authentication and access choices to fraud, privacy, governance, and incident response. The value isn’t another feature list; it’s seeing how a control changes risk, user friction, evidence, and recovery work.
- **Hands-on learning:** Use workshops and technical sessions to develop skills that support an active program. Choose exercises that expose configuration, policy behavior, or troubleshooting rather than repeating a product overview.
- **Vendor review:** See competing products and integration models in the same week using a common scenario. Record what was demonstrated, what requires another vendor, the product roadmap, and what still needs technical proof.
- **Community perspective:** Discuss standards and implementation lessons beyond a single vendor’s point of view. Capture the environment behind each lesson so your team can judge whether it transfers to its own identity populations and regulatory obligations.


Define the outcomes you hope to gain before you choose which sessions to attend. That keeps a busy agenda from becoming four days of unrelated notes.


## Where to stay for Identiverse 2027


Mandalay Bay is a large resort and convention campus at the south end of the Las Vegas Strip. Staying onsite reduces outdoor exposure and makes it easier to return to the room between sessions, but nearby properties may offer better rates or loyalty options.

Casino-resort walking times are easy to underestimate. Compare the route from the room tower to the conference entrance, not just the distance between properties.


It’s a good idea to stay within Mandalay Bay if early workshops, frequent room resets, or heat avoidance are important to you. Luxor and Excalibur can broaden the rate comparison while keeping the team on the south Strip, but the indoor route still takes time. A central Strip hotel adds restaurant and meeting options. You can treat it as a daily commute and price rideshare, transit, and lost schedule time alongside the room.


### Identiverse hotel pricing


Navan’s anonymized Las Vegas city-level data for the comparison period in 2026 (June 15–19), included 1,393 hotel stays. The median nightly rate was $180, the median booking lead was 15 days, and 48.6% of stays were booked within two weeks.


- **0–7 days before check-in:** Median $154 across 406 stays.
- **8–14 days before check-in:** Median $179 across 262 stays.
- **15–30 days before check-in:** Median $199 across 313 stays.
- **31–60 days before check-in:** Median $192 across 240 stays.
- **61 or more days before check-in:** Median $214 across 159 stays.


These are citywide business-travel bookings, not Mandalay Bay room-block results. The higher early-booking medians may reflect a different property and room mix, so use the figures as a range and compare total stay cost, cancellation terms, and indoor travel time.


### Identiverse flight trends


The same booking window included 3,628 inbound flight segments to Las Vegas, with 2.9% international. San Francisco, Chicago, Phoenix, Salt Lake City, and Dallas–Fort Worth were the largest origin cities. Arriving Sunday for a Monday start makes the arrival more relaxed than arriving very early on Monday, with more time to check in, collect credentials, or prepare for an early workshop.

## How to set your Las Vegas budget


Before travelling. budget for registration, airfare, room rate, resort fees, taxes, meals, ocal transportation, any workshop or team-dinner cost. The current registration page lists $1,695 for general registration and $1,395 for eligible government, nonprofit, and education attendees, with group discounts for teams of 3 or more.\[2\]


### Federal per diem for Las Vegas


The FY 2027 Las Vegas rate for June and July is $120 per night for lodging and $86 per full day for meals and incidental expenses, a combined daily benchmark of $206 before lodging taxes.\[4\]


M&IE is divided into $22 for breakfast, $23 for lunch, $36 for dinner, and $5 for incidentals. First and last travel days are $64.50 when the federal 75% rule applies.


The $180 median in Navan’s Identiverse 2026 proxy was $60 above the federal lodging allowance. Compare the full resort total with your company’s actual policy rather than using the room rate alone.


### Other expenses to consider.


Beyond the expenses mentioned, there are often forgotten or hidden costs that sneak into the overall budget:


- **Registration and workshops:** Separate the published pass price from any paid workshop, training, or add-on so the approval shows what each attendee will use.
- **Hotel charges:** Add resort fees, hotel taxes, deposits, and cancellation terms to the room comparison. On the Strip, the displayed nightly rate is only part of the stay cost.
- **Airport and local rides:** Budget both airport transfers and any ride used to avoid a long outdoor walk or move to an off-property meeting.
- **Meals:** Check which meals the conference provides and how your employer handles deductions. Resort prices can make an unplanned lunch materially different from a meal included with registration.
- **Business dinners:** Set the attendee list, payer, objective, and cancellation deadline before booking a client, partner, or team meal. Private rooms and group menus may carry minimums.
- **Booth and demo materials:** Include checked baggage, shipping, handling, storage, and return logistics rather than keeping one vague equipment allowance.
- **Heat-related purchases:** Water, sunscreen, and convenience purchases are predictable in late June. Stock the room before the first full day instead of repeatedly paying resort pricing between sessions.


## How to plan your Identiverse agenda


The conference dates are confirmed for Monday, June 28, through Thursday, July 1, 2027, at Mandalay Bay. Identiverse describes a four-day mix of keynotes, curated sessions, hands-on learning, and show-floor activity. The detailed 2027 timetable will be published closer to the date.\[1\]


Building flexibility into your schedule will allow you to gain the most value from your attendance:


- **Questions:** Tag every session to an active decision or learning goal. Keep one alternate in the same program area and drop sessions that repeat context your team already understands.
- **Workshops:** Register early when capacity or prerequisites apply. Confirm what account, laptop access, software, or background knowledge is expected so the first part of the workshop isn’t spent solving avoidable setup problems.
- **Vendor meetings:** Share architecture boundaries, identity populations, deployment constraints, and the safe version of your use case before the demo begins. Ask the vendor to distinguish live capability from roadmap, partner dependency, and professional services.
- **Recovery:** Leave one daily block for notes, follow-up, and heat-safe movement. Mandalay Bay is large, and crossing the resort or moving outdoors can take more energy than the agenda suggests.


Keep an evidence column in your notes: demonstrated, documented, customer-reported, or unverified. Identity decisions carry security and compliance consequences, so the provenance of an answer matters as much as the answer itself.


## What to pack for Identiverse 2027


Las Vegas in late June is extremely hot outdoors. The 1991–2020 normal June high is about 99°F and the normal low is about 76°F; June is also the driest month of the year.\[5\] Indoor spaces can feel cold by comparison.


Here are some recommendations to help ensure a comfortable conference:


- Breathable business-casual clothing
- Light layer for cold meeting rooms
- Comfortable shoes for a large resort campus
- Refillable water bottle and sunscreen
- Battery pack and chargers
- Laptop privacy screen if you’ll work in public areas
- Short architecture or requirements brief for technical meetings


## Getting from LAS to Mandalay Bay


Mandalay Bay is approximately 2 miles from Harry Reid International Airport. The resort offers a 24-hour taxi stand and designated rideshare access; airport shuttles and limousine services are also available.\[3\]

## Beyond sessions: Use the identity community as a design review


While the conference agenda will be packed with value, amazing outcomes can come from the work that happens between sessions. Bring a diagram, control question, or user journey that you can discuss without exposing sensitive information. Remove tenant names, credentials, customer data, network details, and other secrets, but retain the trust boundaries and exception paths that make the design question real.


Use the show floor to test integrations, migration assumptions, administrative effort, policy behavior, and support models. Be sure to also ask what happens during enrollment failure, account recovery, federation outage, privilege escalation, or a migration rollback. It’s as important as a successful path.


Save marketing claims separately from capabilities you observed or found in current documentation. Before leaving a booth, agree on the next evidence: architecture guide, standards mapping, sandbox access, reference customer, security review, or deeper technical session.


## How to network without losing focus


Identity conversations can become abstract quickly. Write down the environment, constraint, and evidence behind each recommendation so your team can judge whether it applies later. Include whether the speaker was describing workforce identity, customer identity, privileged access, fraud, machine identity, or another domain. Similar terminology can hide very different implementation realities.


Follow up with the document or question that was discussed. For the most important contacts, a short but specific message within 48 hours tends to be more useful than a broad recap sent to everyone you scanned. Keep sensitive architecture in approved channels and use the first message to arrange a secure follow-up or next steps.


Leave enough unscheduled time to compare notes with your own team or even with yourself to gather your findings. A short daily review can expose contradictory or unclear advice early, while the right practitioner or vendor is still onsite to clarify it.


## What to eat at Identiverse 2027


Mandalay Bay and the south Strip keep travel short in extreme heat. Central Strip restaurants add variety but can require more time to get to. Here are some ideas for meals you might need on your schedule:


- **Client or executive dinner — Orla:** Orla at Mandalay Bay serves Mediterranean and Middle Eastern dishes with a seafood focus and offers private dining and event options. It suits a smaller, higher-stakes dinner when the team wants a polished setting without leaving the conference resort.\[6\]
- **Team or partner meal — Border Grill:** Border Grill is inside Mandalay Bay between the convention center and Shark Reef, with group-dining options and several private rooms. Its shared modern Mexican dishes and flexible spaces work well for a cross-functional team or partner group.\[7\]
- **Quick breakfast or late meal — Citizens Kitchen & Bar:** Citizens is in the heart of Mandalay Bay, serves breakfast and American comfort food, and operates a late-night counter. It’s the practical choice when the schedule leaves little time or when teammates arrive and finish at different hours.\[8\]


Request a quieter table for architecture or risk discussions, confirm dietary requirements, and ask whether a group menu or minimum spend applies. Walking through a casino resort can take longer than the property map suggests, so build the restaurant route into the final meeting invitation. ## Finish strong on departure day


The last day of a conference can be tiring, and it’s easy to want to close things once you return home. We recommend using the last morning to note your conclusions and takeaways, and separate them from questions that still need testing. Here are some ways to stay on top of your trip even on that last day:


- **Separate evidence from claims:** Mark which vendor statements need documentation, a security review, standards validation, or a proof of concept.
- **Assign the follow-up:** Give standards, architecture, security, procurement, and commercial questions distinct owners and due dates. A single “follow up with vendor” task hides the fact that several teams may need different evidence.
- **Confirm the airport move:** Check the terminal, rideshare or taxi pickup point, and traffic before retrieving bags. Add time for the walk from the conference space to the hotel lobby.
- **Close expenses:** Save work-trip receipts according to your company’s process. Add any attendees and business purpose to group meal receipts before the details blur together.
- **Schedule the decision meeting:** Put the team debrief on the calendar before leaving Mandalay Bay and circulate the open-question list first. Use the meeting to approve tests and owners.


## Make your Identiverse 2027 trip count


A successful outcome of Identiverse 2027 doesn’t necessarily mean you attended the most sessions, but that you left with a clearer identity decision. Stay close enough to protect your energy and time, test every recommendation against your own environment, and leave Las Vegas with a small set of next steps your security, product, and architecture teams can evaluate.
